sla_onsite.text: contact information. Warranty The contractor shall provide a minimum manufacturer or contractor warranty covering parts and labor for the complete workstation configuration. Warranty coverage shall include the processor, motherboard, memory, storage devices, power supply, cooling components, chassis, and all four installed GPUs. The contractor shall identify warranty duration, support procedures, and replacement or repair timelines in its proposal. Contractor Responsibilities The contractor is responsible for verifying final component compatibility before shipment, including but not limited to: - CPU-to-motherboard compatibility; - PCIe lane availability and GPU slot configuration; - GPU physical dimensions and slot spacing; - Power draw and connector requirements; - Thermal performance under multi-GPU loads; - Chassis airflow and component clearance; and - Driver and operating-system compatibility.
